## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and the reason for the change.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Relevant Playwright and responsive checks completed

## Safety and content quality

- [ ] No credentials, private keys, personal exports, or production data are included
- [ ] Firestore/Storage rule changes were tested with both allowed and denied cases
- [ ] Mathematics and physics answers or templates were independently verified
- [ ] Offline/sync behavior was considered for any progress-writing change
- [ ] Accessibility and reduced-motion behavior were checked for UI changes
